description: NaFe₃H₆(SO₇)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and faces with six equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are six shorter (2.92 Å) and six longer (3.05 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. There are four shorter (2.01 Å) and two longer (2.09 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra and corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There is one shorter (1.46 Å) and three longer (1.51 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Fe, and one H atom.
